items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: And, then, of course, we came back in the Grand Terrace and there was a guy producing the shows named Percy Venable.

ctx.x: This was one of the greatest producers I've ever seen. What a mind he had. I didn't know this man was very heavy on dope at that time. But, you know, he would rehearse that show and rehearse that show and get it all together and until the last day when the show was about to open, we'd be rehearsing up until almost opening time. He would throw the finale together. And, it would be a classic. What a mind this cat had for shows. Percy Venable.
Well, I remember something about him. See if you can double check it. He had the longest fingernails of anybody I'd ever seen.
